name: Example Unity Tool
shortDescription: A demo editor tool with a video preview and an itch.io page.
description:
This is a placeholder description for the Example Unity Tool. It demonstrates a few optional features at once:

- **Video media:** its preview is rendered as a video player with controls.
- **An itch.io page:** it is the only demo asset with an `itchUrl`, so it is the only one showing the View on itch.io button.
- **Short documentation:** three sections, below the table-of-contents threshold.
- **A changelog:** the version and last-updated info on its page come from the newest changelog entry.
